title: Vision Foundation Models in Agriculture: Toward Domain-Specific Adaptation for Weed Herbicide Trials Assessment
mechanism: Self-supervised adaptation of a general VFM on a curated domain set; gains concentrate on unseen conditions.
adaptation: Evidence to make E1 crack recall / relF1@2 the primary metric of every SSL arm, with test / folds as non-inferiority.
min_experiment: No standalone run; sets the metric for D32 arms.
evidence: R: species F1 0.91 to 0.94 standard, 0.56 to 0.66 unseen; damage 0.17 to 0.27 unseen; +5.4% F1 with 80% fewer labels.
